title: Supreme Decadence
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Supreme Decadence}}
'''Supreme Decadence''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] which causes [[life]] recovery from [[flask]]s to also apply to [[energy shield]], but reduces the recovery amount. Life flask effects are still removed on full life. The amount recovered is based on the life recovery, regardless of your maximum Energy Shield value.

This keystone is not on the default character skill tree. See [[#Related unique items]] for item needed to have this keystone.
{{#ev:youtube|v0eVaddwL0o|500}}

==Location==
This keystone will replace (in-game wording: [[Timeless Jewel#Conquered|conquered]]) any keystones within the radius of a {{il|Elegant Hubris}} jewel with modifier {{c|mod|Commissioned (2000-160000) coins to commemorate '''Cadiro'''}}.

==Related unique items==
The following [[unique item]]s are related to Supreme Decadence:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Supreme Decadence%"
    OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Conquered%by%the%Eternal%Empire%"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

* [[The Sorrow of the Divine]] and [[Replica Sorrow of the Divine]] also provide a similar effect to this keystone.
